heading: ## Acceptance Criteria
replacement:
- [ ] New Plan Estimation Forecast comments store each comparable issue exactly once, inside a collapsed `<details>` block containing `<ul id="comparableIssues">`; the hidden record contains only the external-list descriptor rather than the comparable array.
- [ ] The descriptor records the fixed element ID, item count, encoding version, and SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical comparable array, while the existing whole-payload hash continues to authenticate the reconstructed logical forecast.
- [ ] Comment readers strictly parse the external list, reconstruct the existing in-memory `comparableIssues` array before returning the record, and fail closed for missing or duplicate IDs, malformed item JSON, count drift, fingerprint drift, or semantic tampering.
- [ ] Historical forecast comments with embedded `comparableIssues` arrays remain readable without migration or edits to closed issues.
- [ ] Empty and large comparable sets render and round-trip deterministically, and focused tests plus the repository fast and slow lanes remain green.
